entries.text: you choose a time limit, and then immediately turn into mist for exactly that long.  You have no senses and are unaware of the passage of time while in mist form.
entries.raw_text: 1,you choose a time limit, and then immediately turn into mist for exactly that long.  You have no senses and are unaware of the passage of time while in mist form.

entries.text: you are permanently floating 5ft off the ground.  You must push off something in order to move.
entries.raw_text: 1,you are permanently floating 5ft off the ground.  You must push off something in order to move.

entries.text: you can jump 10ft in the air, without a running start.
entries.raw_text: 1,you can jump 10ft in the air, without a running start.

entries.text: a putrid stench constantly surrounds you: creatures within 15ft vomit copiously unless they make a STR save.
entries.raw_text: 1,a putrid stench constantly surrounds you: creatures within 15ft vomit copiously unless they make a STR save.

entries.text: you can create a 10ft section of crystal wall.  Up to 4 sections can exist at a time: the oldest one will vanish when another is created.
entries.raw_text: 1,you can create a 10ft section of crystal wall.  Up to 4 sections can exist at a time: the oldest one will vanish when another is created.

entries.text: you can become a stone statue until you decide to change back.  You have Armour 3, are completely immobile, and can hear but not see.
entries.raw_text: 1,you can become a stone statue until you decide to change back.  You have Armour 3, are completely immobile, and can hear but not see.

entries.text: you can charge yourself with electricity, dealing d10 Damage to the next person who touches you.
entries.raw_text: 1,you can charge yourself with electricity, dealing d10 Damage to the next person who touches you.

entries.text: you can see inside sealed containers (chests, barrels, etc) with X-ray vision.
entries.raw_text: 1,you can see inside sealed containers (chests, barrels, etc) with X-ray vision.

entries.text: you become invisible as long as you are standing in a shadow.
entries.raw_text: 1,you become invisible as long as you are standing in a shadow.

entries.text: you cannot make any sound, even on purpose.
entries.raw_text: 1,you cannot make any sound, even on purpose.

entries.text: you can breathe underwater indefinitely.  This power doesn't protect items from water damage.
entries.raw_text: 1,you can breathe underwater indefinitely.  This power doesn't protect items from water damage.

entries.text: you randomly teleport by 10ft every time you take Damage.
entries.raw_text: 1,you randomly teleport by 10ft every time you take Damage.

entries.text: you can reflect rays/beams back upon themselves by passing a WIL save.
entries.raw_text: 1,you can reflect rays/beams back upon themselves by passing a WIL save.

entries.text: a plant you touch can speak, until the power is next used.  Flowers are gossipy, trees are wise.
entries.raw_text: 1,a plant you touch can speak, until the power is next used.  Flowers are gossipy, trees are wise.

entries.text: you have turned into living ice.  You have Armour 1, and deal d6 Damage while unarmed.  Fire attacks on you are enhanced, cold attacks are impaired.
entries.raw_text: 1,you have turned into living ice.  You have Armour 1, and deal d6 Damage while unarmed.  Fire attacks on you are enhanced, cold attacks are impaired.

entries.text: you can change a 10ft area from rock to sand, or vice-versa.  Lasts until the power is next used.
entries.raw_text: 1,you can change a 10ft area from rock to sand, or vice-versa.  Lasts until the power is next used.

entries.text: a piece of text you indicate becomes scrambled gibberish until you decide to return it to normal.
entries.raw_text: 1,a piece of text you indicate becomes scrambled gibberish until you decide to return it to normal.

entries.text: you can eat stone (excreting sand), but can no longer eat normal food. Some types of stone are stodgy, (un)healthy, sweet, savoury, etc.
entries.raw_text: 1,you can eat stone (excreting sand), but can no longer eat normal food. Some types of stone are stodgy, (un)healthy, sweet, savoury, etc.

entries.text: you can convert metal into a random type of fungal matter.  Roll 1d8: (1) Burns warmly like firewood, long-lasting greenish flame.  (2) Nutritious and tasty!  Makes a good meal all by itself.  (3) When touched, phosphoresces brightly for a few minutes.  (4) Explodes into a 10ft butt of spores when struck hard (lose d6 DEX).  (5) If disturbed, collapses into 10ft puddle of slime (DEX save or fall over).  (6) Mushroom cap fires off like a rocket (d12 Damage) when lit.  (7) Vile medicinal taste, cures d6 STR loss.  (8) Far out!  Everything looks so cosmic now. (lasts d6 hours)
